payload.description:
## Intent

As an operator, I want scan packets for every published Pilobolus article so I can steer findings myself.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Published article scan packets
  As the Pilobolus editor
  I want a scan of each live article against the house profile
  So I can mark skip or rewrite myself

  Scenario: Scan does not steer
    Given the latest published articles on Pilobol.us origin/main
    And the Papyrus pilobolus style profile
    When I run limatus scan on each article
    Then I get findings with ids and sources
    And the scan JSON contains no skip or rewrite decisions
    And the article files are unchanged
```
payload.title: Scan packets for published Pilobolus articles
